name: vanilla-plus-arsenal
title: Vanilla+ Arsenal
author: deadrat22
description: Turret variety for a mostly vanilla game: five standalone turret mods, each with one job, plus small balance tweaks that keep all of them worth building. Buffs, not nerfs: gun turret range 18-24 with double per-shot damage (half the ammo belt for the same kills), laser turret range 24-28 with double per-shot damage. The five turret mods are required dependencies, so installing this one pulls them automatically. Vanilla ammo wherever possible.
